name: repository-guidance
description: Create, adapt, and audit repository instructions against local architecture, tooling, tests, and authority instead of importing another project’s assumptions.

interface.longDescription: Create, adapt, and audit repository instructions using the target project’s actual ownership boundaries, development commands, state and API contracts, testing layers, and delivery policies. Keep upstream conventions as evidence to evaluate, preserve local authority, and report unsupported assumptions.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository’s agent instructions against its code and policies. Report proposed changes without editing files.
Adapt engineering conventions to this repository and update its existing AGENTS.md within the requested scope.
